study type: Action research (guideline development and feasibility assessment)
outcome: Prevention and control of healthcare-associated COVID-19 infection
cohort: A pilot group of three pregnant women with COVID-19 infection undergoing caesarean section participated in the feasibility testing of the guideline.
finding: The Clinical Nursing Practice Guideline (CNPG) for preventing and controlling COVID-19 infection in pregnant women undergoing caesarean section demonstrated high overall feasibility (M=2.69, SD=0.35, p<0.05).
